name: Monster Mutt

specialAbility.name: Fetch!
specialAbility.description: Monster Mutt leaps through the air and pounces on the enemy like a giant puppy catching a ball -- for 25 damage!

lore: Half truck, half giant puppy, ALL trouble! Monster Mutt has big floppy ears that flap in the wind, a waggy tail on the back, and a tongue hanging out the front. It gets the zoomies in the middle of battle and bounces around the arena like the world's most destructive good boy. Who's a good truck? MONSTER MUTT IS!
